title: Saw Meng Tee buys shares of Food Empire Holdings Ltd
body: Saw Meng Tee bought 36,000 shares of Food Empire Holdings Ltd. This increases their holdings from 246,000 to 282,000 shares.

circumstances_desc: On 30 September 2026, Quan Min Holdings Pte. Ltd. ("QMH") and Dr Ng Chin Siau, disposed of 7,400,000  and 6,600,000 ordinary shares in the Company respectively via private, off-market transactions (married deals) for a total consideration of S$3,700,000 and S$3,300,000 respectively (excluding brokerage fees and stamp duties). Dr Ng Chin Siau is deemed to have an interest in the shares of Q & M Dental Group (Singapore) Limited held by QMH. Please refer to section 9 and the Remarks section for more information. Table 1.
